review_description: Sales quoting process was thorough and our sales consultant was willing to talk us through all of our questions and respond in a very timely manner. Nothing was too much trouble.The install of our 24kW system took place over 3 days ... there was a delay of 1 day as a result of the availability of our panels .. but once they arrived the team worked tirelessly over the weekend (Say & Sun)  to get the job done. There was some slight damage to our render on our house which was promptly repaired.We are very pleased with the end result.

Great engagement with SolarGain to get the optimal system for our home. Five options given before we landed on our design. Micro-inverters on quality panels are great. Installation was flawless. Team arrived at 0700 and were gone by 1030; 23 panels all wired in. Great service, everything cleaned after the installation. Enphase connection happened in seven working days. Great service. I’d recommend SolarGain anytime.

We've had the PV system and iStore hot water installed, now waiting on the battery to arrive from Huawei. 15k Qantas points is a bonus to use on our next holiday away :-)Installer had to reschedule as with a little bit of rain, the slippery terracotta tiles weren't safe to walk on, but got the system installed a week later than expected. Installers were tidy and even swept the driveway after they were done!Chose to get 270L iStore to replace the old electric tank we had, and the iStore timer is set to run from 10am to heat our water when we are exporting solar power.
